notes: Rural site, Cherry Springs State Park, PA (paper: 'Rural'). Calibrated by the authors' MATLAB pipeline (IlluminationSpectraDataset_Analysis_Preprocess). Transposed: columns = spectra (1/min), rows 1–5 timestamp, date/night, solar elevation (deg), lunar elevation (deg), lunar illuminated fraction; rows 6–566 = 561 values, 280–840 nm at 1 nm (repo README Table S1), absolute downwelling vector spectral irradiance W·m⁻²·nm⁻¹ (paper Methods: radiance × π). Two OceanOptics USB2000+ spectrometers with a custom downwelling-irradiance probe; spectra with any saturated value discarded; negative values after dark subtraction set to 0 (paper Methods).
